text: ETF资金流向观察｜宽基ETF单日吸金177亿元，行业主题ETF净流入52.68亿元，科技成长方向获集中增持，信用债指数ETF净流出17.64亿元
text_en: ETF fund flow observation | Broad-based ETFs attracted 17.7 billion yuan in a single day, sector-themed ETFs saw net inflows of 5.268 billion yuan, tech growth direction received concentrated increases, credit bond index ETFs saw net outflows of 1.764 billion yuan
